# Elystra

> Revenue infrastructure for agencies. Proposal-to-cash rail: scope, send, sign, collect, follow up, operate.

Elystra is B2B software for marketing, creative, and performance agencies doing 5+ proposals per month.

## Product

Elystra provides four modules on one rail:
1. Proposal Engine — AI scope from call transcripts
2. Close Rail — sign-and-pay in one flow
3. Deal Intelligence — behavior-driven follow-up
4. Client Portal — post-close ops and retention
